Other Response
The preceding letters from the Richmond Redevelopment and Housing Authority, the Federal Aviation Administration, the Virginia Department of Highways, the Virginia Department of Health, and the Randolph Planning Study Board essentially need no reply. They are included to complete the entire set of responses that HUD has received for the Draft Environmental Statement on Randolph.
The following agencies or organizations have failed to respond to the Draft Statement, although they were included on the original distribution list:
Office of Economic Opportunity
Governor's Council on the Environment
Richmond Regional Planning District Commission
Conservation Council of Virginia
Division of State Planning and Community Affairs
Richmond Metropolitan Authority
